source.name: Pokémon GO Wiki (Fandom)
source.note: Community information, paraphrased. Not from the game's data and not verified: methods change with events and updates.

items.ITEM_SUN_STONE: Small chance from spinning PokéStops and Gyms. A 7-day spin streak guarantees one of the Johto evolution items (Sun Stone, King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Upgrade). Also from research tasks and Gifts.
items.ITEM_KINGS_ROCK: Small chance from spinning PokéStops and Gyms. A 7-day spin streak guarantees one of the Johto evolution items (Sun Stone, King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Upgrade). Also from research tasks and Gifts.

items.ITEM_UP_GRADE: Small chance from spinning PokéStops and Gyms. A 7-day spin streak guarantees one of the Johto evolution items (Sun Stone, King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Upgrade). Also from research tasks and Gifts.
items.ITEM_GEN4_EVOLUTION_STONE: From Research Breakthrough rewards and from Trainer Battles.
items.ITEM_GEN5_EVOLUTION_STONE: From Research Breakthrough rewards and from defeating Team GO Rocket Leaders.
items.ITEM_OTHER_EVOLUTION_STONE_A: By catching or walking with Gimmighoul, and by spinning Golden PokéStops.
items.ITEM_OTHER_EVOLUTION_STONE_MAPLE_A: Tap apples on the map. They appear more often next to a PokéStop with a Mossy Lure Module.

items.ITEM_TROY_DISK_GLACIAL: Sold in the Shop. Also a reward from research tasks and PokéStop Showcases.
